title: Forward Deployed Engineering
subtitle: From Ambiguous Workflow to Production Outcome
description: A practical field book for converting ambiguous customer workflows into secure, adopted, supportable production systems and reusable product learning.
author: Komal Nakrani

chapters.title: The Deployed Outcome
chapters.summary: Define the Forward Deployed Engineer's unit of accountability, lifecycle, role boundary, and evidence-based meaning of done.

chapters.title: Enter the Customer System
chapters.summary: Plan legitimate discovery, distinguish stakeholder dimensions, minimize access and data, and keep evidence confidence explicit.

chapters.title: Map the Workflow That Actually Exists
chapters.summary: Model actors, decisions, state, data, tools, handoffs, incentives, exceptions, and failure cost without idealizing the current workflow.

chapters.title: Contract for an Outcome
chapters.summary: Turn workflow evidence into measurable outcomes, guardrails, adoption signals, decision rights, assumptions, non-goals, and exit criteria.

chapters.title: Scope the First Safe Production Path
chapters.summary: Select the least exposed end-to-end path that produces representative production evidence with explicit dependencies, uncertainty, change, and stop criteria.

chapters.title: Draw the Real System Boundary
chapters.summary: Express structural, runtime, data, trust, failure, and responsibility boundaries with explicit ownership and architecture decisions.

chapters.title: Make Interfaces and Data Explicit
chapters.summary: Design versioned API, event, and data contracts with explicit semantics, quality, idempotent intent, exceptions, and reconciliation.

chapters.title: Fit the Customer Environment
chapters.summary: Translate the logical design into explicit deployment topology, identity, secrets, configuration, tenancy, regional, network, capacity, and environment responsibilities.

chapters.title: Put AI Inside a Bounded Workflow
chapters.summary: Decide when AI belongs, decompose tasks, bound model and tool behavior, evaluate by workflow consequence, and preserve deterministic controls and accountable human decisions.

chapters.title: Build Security and Governance Into Delivery
chapters.summary: Turn threats and risks into proportionate controls, implementation evidence, minimized access and data, and decisions routed to designated authorities.

chapters.title: Build a Production Vertical Slice
chapters.summary: Implement one small, reviewable path across contracts, data, integrations, bounded AI, authorization, audit, telemetry, configuration, and controlled failure.

chapters.title: Prove Behavior Before Production
chapters.summary: Trace workflow risk and acceptance claims to typed verification evidence, representative segments, calibrated graders, task-based UAT, limitations, and release disposition.

chapters.title: Make the System Observable and Operable
chapters.summary: Design promise-linked signals, actionable objectives and alerts, privacy-safe cohort views, support feedback, and evidence-first diagnostic paths.

chapters.title: Engineer Release and Recovery
chapters.summary: Bind versioned artifacts and evidence to progressive release gates, compatible migration, explicit recovery choice, verified restoration, and executed rehearsal.

chapters.title: Cross the Production Threshold
chapters.summary: Use readiness evidence, unresolved risk, authority, cohort design, signals, communications, and recovery triggers to choose go, conditional go, reduced scope, delay, or stop.
